How a Funeral Home Negligence Attorney Can Help

An experienced personal injury lawyer in Colorado can help you and your family go up against a funeral home in pursuit of fair financial compensation for the harm and losses your family has suffered due to careless, reckless or wrongful acts by a funeral director or staff member. This may include your pain, suffering, emotional distress and mental anguish regarding the situation. An attorney can investigate the funeral home, search for evidence of negligence or wrongdoing, file a claim for your family, and negotiate a fair and full settlement from an insurance company on your behalf. A lawyer will also have the ability to bring your funeral home negligence case to trial in Colorado, if necessary, to pursue justice.
What Is Funeral Home Negligence?
Funeral home negligence can refer to any act or omission that falls short of a funeral home’s duty or responsibility of care toward its patrons. In 2024, Colorado’s
laws regulating funeral homes

were updated for the first time in more than 40 years after several scandals were discovered regarding how these facilities were operating. Several changes were made to prevent issues and incidents such as:
Failing to background check funeral home employees
Hiring unqualified mortuary science workers and embalmers
Mishandling human remains
Improperly storing human remains in the funeral home
Sexual misconduct or abuse involving human remains
Willfully mutilating or destroying human remains with intent to impair appearance
Illegally selling bodies and body parts
Falsifying cremated remains given to family members
Operating an unregistered crematory
Colorado’s
“abuse of corpse law”
forbids anything that would
“outrage normal family sensibilities”

in the treatment of human remains by a funeral home. However, a civil claim can be brought against a funeral home in Colorado for actions that do not constitute crimes but cause harm or damages to the family, such as the improper handling of a body or delivering fake ashes.
